semantics.chengdu_xian: raw original trajectory[2] GPS points only; road edges are not indexed or queried
semantics.beijing: each adjacent [node_id,lon,lat,timestamp] source pair linearly split into 10 segments by default; N -> 10*(N-1)+1 indexed points
semantics.rtree: 2D longitude/latitude R-tree; timestamp stored only in leaf point entry and checked only after spatial leaf hit
